label: Her vehicle was in Avery's garage
detail: Teresa Halbach's RAV4 (Dassey calls it 'her jeep') was parked inside Steven Avery's garage that evening.
source: Decision and Order, Dassey v. Dittmann (E.D. Wis. Aug 12, 2016), p. 9, citing ECF 19-25 at 24. The vehicle's discovery on the salvage yard was public by Nov 10, 2005 (CNN); its being in the garage was not reported.

label: A knife
detail: Avery had or showed a knife.
source: Decision and Order p. 9, citing ECF 19-25 at 26.

label: She was tied up with rope
detail: Halbach was bound with rope.
source: Decision and Order pp. 9-12, citing ECF 19-25 at 26, 54, 56-57.

label: Her body was in the back of the RAV4
detail: Halbach was placed in the rear cargo area of her vehicle.
aliases: in the back of the jeep
in the back of the car
source: Decision and Order pp. 9-10, 14, citing ECF 19-25 at 26, 71-72. Public: 'Halbach's blood was found in the cargo area of the RAV4' was reported before March 1, 2006 (Decision and Order p. 70, citing Herald Times Reporter, Nov. 16, 2005 and Dec. 7, 2005).
public_what: Halbach's blood in the cargo area of the RAV4 (Decision and Order p. 70)

label: Restrained on the bed in Avery's bedroom
detail: Halbach was held, restrained with handcuffs, on the bed in Avery's bedroom.
source: Decision and Order p. 11, citing ECF 19-25 at 42-43.

label: Stabbed in the stomach
detail: Halbach was stabbed in the stomach.
source: Decision and Order p. 12, citing ECF 19-25 at 54-55.

label: Strangled until unconscious
detail: Halbach was choked until she lost consciousness.
source: Decision and Order p. 12, citing ECF 19-25 at 55.

label: Her hair was cut
detail: Some of Halbach's hair was cut off.
source: Decision and Order p. 13, citing ECF 19-25 at 60.

label: Her throat was cut
detail: Halbach's throat was cut.
source: Decision and Order p. 13, citing ECF 19-25 at 62.

label: Shot in the head
detail: Halbach was shot in the head.
source: Decision and Order pp. 12-13, citing ECF 19-25 at 63. Investigators already knew this from forensic examination of the skull fragments (ECF 19-19 at 85; 19-20 at 27). Not reported publicly before the interviews (not in CNN Nov 10, 2005 or Badger Herald Nov 16, 2005). The Decision says that she 'had been shot in the head' apparently had not been publicly disclosed as of March 1, 2006 (Decision and Order p. 70).

label: Shot with a .22 rifle
detail: The gun was a .22 caliber rifle, Avery's.
source: Decision and Order p. 14, citing ECF 19-25 at 63-67, 103. Firearms found in Avery's bedroom were reported (Badger Herald, Nov 16, 2005) but not linked to a shooting. Partly public: '11 rifle casings were found in Avery's garage' and 'two rifles were recovered from Avery's bedroom' were reported before March 1, 2006 (Decision and Order pp. 69–70, citing Herald Times Reporter, Nov. 16, 2005 and Dec. 7, 2005); the .22 caliber was not in that list.
public_what: rifle casings in Avery's garage and two rifles from his bedroom, not the .22 caliber (Decision and Order pp. 69–70)

label: Shot inside the garage
detail: The shooting happened inside Avery's garage.
source: Decision and Order pp. 14-15, citing ECF 19-25 at 72-73. Investigators told Dassey they had found shell casings in the garage (ECF 19-25 at 73). Public: '11 rifle casings were found in Avery's garage' was reported before March 1, 2006 (Decision and Order p. 69, citing Herald Times Reporter, Nov. 16, 2005 and Dec. 7, 2005).
public_what: 11 rifle casings found in Avery's garage (Decision and Order p. 69)

label: Her body was burned in the fire behind the garage
detail: Halbach's body was put in the bonfire in the burn pit behind Avery's garage.
source: Decision and Order pp. 3, 7, 10, 14. Public: 'human teeth and bones in a burn pit behind Steven Avery's garage' (Badger Herald, Nov 16, 2005); 'an attempt was made to dispose of a body by an incendiary means' (CNN, Nov 10, 2005). Also listed as reported before March 1, 2006: 'her remains were found in Avery's burn pit along with remnants of clothing' (Decision and Order p. 69, citing Herald Times Reporter, Nov. 16, 2005 and Dec. 7, 2005).
public_what: remains in Avery's burn pit (Decision and Order p. 69; Badger Herald, Nov 16, 2005)

label: Tires and branches were put on the fire
detail: Tires and branches were added on top of her in the fire.
source: Decision and Order p. 14, citing ECF 19-25 at 68-69. Partly public: 'Avery burned tires on the night Halbach was last seen' was reported before March 1, 2006 (Decision and Order p. 69, citing Herald Times Reporter, Nov. 16, 2005 and Dec. 7, 2005); the branches on the fire were not in that list.
public_what: Avery burned tires that night; the branches were not reported (Decision and Order p. 69)

label: The RAV4 was hidden in the salvage yard under branches and a car hood
detail: The vehicle was driven into the salvage yard and covered with branches and a vehicle hood.
source: Decision and Order pp. 1-2, 15, citing ECF 19-25 at 76-77. That the SUV was found on the property was public (CNN, Nov 10, 2005); how it was covered was not reported there. Public: the RAV4 'was found in the salvage yard partially concealed by branches and a car hood' was reported before March 1, 2006 (Decision and Order p. 69, citing Herald Times Reporter, Nov. 16, 2005 and Dec. 7, 2005).
public_what: the RAV4 in the salvage yard partially concealed by branches and a car hood (Decision and Order p. 69)

label: The license plates were removed
detail: The plates were taken off the RAV4.
source: Decision and Order p. 16, citing ECF 19-25 at 77-78. Public: 'Halbach's license plates were found crumpled in a scrap vehicle at the salvage yard' (Badger Herald, Nov 16, 2005).
public_what: license plates found crumpled in a scrap vehicle (Badger Herald, Nov 16, 2005)

label: Avery raised the RAV4's hood
detail: Avery opened the hood of the RAV4 (the battery had been disconnected).
source: Decision and Order p. 16, citing ECF 19-25 at 79-80. Investigators knew the battery had been disconnected (ECF 19-17 at 142); not reported publicly. The Decision says that 'the battery to the RAV4 had been disconnected' apparently had not been publicly disclosed as of March 1, 2006 (Decision and Order p. 70).

label: The vehicle key was put in Avery's bedroom
detail: Avery put the RAV4 key in his bedroom (a dresser drawer).
source: Decision and Order pp. 3, 16, citing ECF 19-25 at 78-79. Public: 'the ignition key to Ms. Halbach's car was found in Steven Avery's bedroom' (CNN, Nov 10, 2005). Also listed as reported before March 1, 2006: 'a key to Halbach's RAV4 was found in Avery's bedroom' (Decision and Order p. 70, citing Herald Times Reporter, Nov. 16, 2005 and Dec. 7, 2005).
public_what: the RAV4 key found in Avery's bedroom (CNN, Nov 10, 2005; Decision and Order p. 70)

label: Bleach on his jeans from cleaning the garage floor
detail: Dassey got bleach on his jeans while helping clean the garage floor.
source: Decision and Order p. 7 (told to Fassbender in an evening meeting on Feb 27, 2006, ECF 19-19 at 10-11) and p. 16 (ECF 19-25 at 82).
prior_statement: on the evening of Feb 27, 2006 he told Fassbender he got bleach on his pants helping clean Avery's garage floor (Decision and Order p. 7, citing ECF 19-19 at 10-11)

label: Blood on the garage floor
detail: There was a blood stain on the garage floor that was cleaned up.
source: Decision and Order p. 16, citing ECF 19-25 at 82, 85-86.

label: The bedsheets were burned
detail: Bloody bedding from the bedroom was burned.
source: Decision and Order p. 17, citing ECF 19-25 at 83.

label: Her clothes were burned
detail: Halbach's clothes were burned.
source: Decision and Order p. 17, citing ECF 19-25 at 84. Public: 'Burned clothing and a partially burned shovel were found in a barrel near Avery's trailer' (Badger Herald, Nov 16, 2005). Also listed as reported before March 1, 2006: 'remnants of clothing' in the burn pit (Decision and Order p. 69, citing Herald Times Reporter, Nov. 16, 2005 and Dec. 7, 2005).
public_what: remnants of clothing in the burn pit; burned clothing in a barrel (Decision and Order p. 69; Badger Herald, Nov 16, 2005)

label: Her phone, camera and purse were burned in the burn barrel
detail: Halbach's cell phone, camera and purse were burned in a burn barrel.
source: Decision and Order p. 18, citing ECF 19-25 at 96-98. Not in the CNN (Nov 10) or Badger Herald (Nov 16, 2005) reports reviewed.

label: Bones were broken up with a shovel
detail: Remaining bones were broken up with a shovel and buried or scattered.
source: Decision and Order p. 18, citing ECF 19-25 at 112-13. A partially burned shovel in a barrel was reported (Badger Herald, Nov 16, 2005), not its use on the bones.

label: A tattoo on her stomach
detail: A test detail: investigators asked about a stomach tattoo they knew Halbach did not have.
source: Decision and Order pp. 18-19, citing ECF 19-25 at 138-39 and ECF 19-12 at 45-46 (investigators knew there was no such tattoo; they asked to test whether Dassey was just agreeing).
